card.craftbound.zombie.text: %s: add Rotten Flesh to your hand.
card.craftbound.skeleton.text: %s. %s: add an Arrow to your hand.
card.craftbound.creeper.text: %s: explode, dealing 2 damage to every other mob.
card.craftbound.enderman.text: %s: teleport an enemy mob back to its owner's hand.
card.craftbound.charged_creeper.text: %s: explode, dealing 4 damage to every other mob and the enemy hero.
card.craftbound.evoker.text: %s: summon two Vexes. %s: add a Totem of Undying to your hand.
card.craftbound.ravager.text: No ability. It's just very big.
card.craftbound.piglin_brute.text: %s. Takes 1 less damage from every hit.
card.craftbound.shulker.text: %s. %s. Mobs it hits levitate and can't attack on their next turn.
card.craftbound.wither_skeleton.text: Mobs it damages are withered: they take 1 damage at the start of each of their owner's turns.
card.craftbound.totem_of_undying.text: Give a friendly mob a Totem. When it dies, it's summoned again.
card.craftbound.warden.text: %s. %s: Sonic Boom, dealing 3 damage to every enemy mob.
card.craftbound.wither.text: %s: deal 2 damage to every other mob. %s: add a Nether Star to your hand.
card.craftbound.ender_dragon.text: %s. %s: add a Dragon Egg to your hand.
keyword.craftbound.sprint.desc: Can attack the turn it's summoned.
keyword.craftbound.ranged.desc: Takes no damage back when it attacks.
keyword.craftbound.spawn.desc: Happens when you play this card.
keyword.craftbound.block.desc: Never attacks or hits back. Does its job until broken.
card_class.craftbound.neutral.desc: Any deck can use this card.
card_class.craftbound.fighter.desc: Only Fighter decks can use this card.
card_class.craftbound.builder.desc: Only Builder decks can use this card.
card_class.craftbound.farmer.desc: Only Farmer decks can use this card.
card_ui.craftbound.mob_type.desc: Mob type. Some cards work better with mobs of the same type.
card_ui.craftbound.attack.desc: Damage this mob deals when it attacks.
card_ui.craftbound.health.desc: Damage this mob can take before it dies.
card_ui.craftbound.rarity.desc: How hard this card is to find in packs.
card_ui.craftbound.enchanted.desc: Enchanted: a rare shiny copy. Plays exactly the same.
card_ui.craftbound.token.desc: Made by other cards. Never found in packs.
card_ui.craftbound.pin_hint: Click to pin or unpin the card it creates.
binder_ui.craftbound.how_to: Click cards onto it in your inventory to file them.
binder_ui.craftbound.hint_take_enchanted: Ctrl+click: take an Enchanted copy (Ctrl+Shift: all)
sleeve_ui.craftbound.desc: A card back design for your Deck Case.
